_description: Task13 DRIFT field, FINE transcription -- the 0.1mm grid used for BOTH the near-field solve and the final stitched volume, for the 5x5 LArPix v2a tile at the true 4.4mm pitch, 16cm drift. The coarse sibling (example_gen_pcb_drift_pixel_task13_coarse.json) is the 0.55mm far-field grid. PHASE 4 RETARGET: only the DEPTH and the VOLTAGE moved in this file. Every geometry value is unchanged, because at 0.1mm every true design length is already an exact whole number of cells -- pixelSize 3.5 -> 35 cells, pixelGap 0.9 -> 9, chamfer_r 0.7 -> 7 (via int(round()) in the generator; 0.7/0.1 is 6.999999999999999 in binary float, so the rounding is load-bearing). NOTHING IS SNAPPED HERE, which is the opposite of the coarse file; here the values ARE the design values. THE BULK FIELD IS NOW 50.0 V/mm, NOT 56.0 -- READ THIS BEFORE 'RESTORING' ANYTHING. CathodePotential = -BulkField * (driftZDepth - pixelPlaneLowEdgePosition) = -50.0 * (160.1 - 9.9) = -50.0 * 150.2 = -7510 V. The FIELD is the round number and the voltage is derived from it, as on the older geometries. This is a DELIBERATE change of the design field, not a rescaling that preserves it. The previous -3878 V existed specifically to hold 56.0 V/mm across the 8cm geometry. That choice has been GIVEN UP. Do not 'fix' this back to 56.0 V/mm: drift velocities and induced currents from this geometry are NOT comparable to the 8cm results, because velo derives mobility from E through a nonlinear LAr parameterisation, so a 10.7% lower field is not a 10.7% slower drift. The value is maintained BY HAND on purpose. The SAME voltage is applied on the coarse and the fine grid, deliberately: it is a boundary condition. 1.1mm IS THE SHARED PERIOD of the 0.1mm and 0.55mm grids, and every plane that must land on both is a whole multiple of it: pitch 4.4 = 44 fine / 8 coarse cells, pad plane 9.9 = 99 / 18, interface 29.7 = 297 / 54, cathode 160.6 = 1606 / 292. PITCH: 3.5 + 0.9 = 4.4mm = 44 fine cells and 8 coarse cells of 0.55mm. hybrid_iterate.py _cells() requires the transverse extent to be a WHOLE number of cells and raises otherwise. PIXEL PLANE LOW EDGE 9.9 IS LOAD-BEARING: 9.9mm is 99 fine cells AND 18 coarse cells of 0.55mm, so the pad plane lands on a real node of BOTH grids. Moving it breaks that co-location. (The generator reads this key with int(), not int(round()) -- gen_pcb_drift_pixel_with_grid.py:474 -- so never reason about it in decimal; 9.9/0.1 is exactly 99.0 and 9.9/0.55 exactly 18.0 in binary float, but neighbouring values are not so lucky.) DEPTH: driftZDepth 160.1 is the electron LAUNCH node, deliberately NOT rounded to 160.6 nor back to 160.05. The cathode sits on the domain's last plane at ceil(160.1/0.55) = 292 coarse cells = 160.6mm, which is 1606 fine cells exactly, so both grids close on the same physical cathode; the launch node itself does not land on that grounded plane, which is the point. The fine z grid is 1607 nodes. 160.05 would break both halves of that: it is exactly 291 coarse cells so the ceil would not advance and the launch node would land ON the cathode, and it is 1600.5 fine cells -- half a cell, which no 0.1mm grid can represent. THE PAD SURFACE THIS FILE DEFINES IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS. padThickness 0.05 and FR4Thickness 0.1 each round to ONE cell here (n_pad is clamped to a 1-cell minimum because 0.05 is half a cell), so the generator derives pp_width = n_pad + n_fr4 - 1 = 1 and the pad TOP is at (99+1)*0.1 = 10.00mm. This fine config and the weighting field's fine config must AGREE on that surface, because both fields' near solves and ALL drift paths live on this 0.1mm grid. The coarse files only supply the far field beyond the 29.7mm interface, where the pad's discretisation no longer shapes the geometry, only the far amplitude. The coarse grid's own pad top is 10.45mm -- a 0.45mm disagreement that is expected and is NOT to be compensated for with different voltages. EXPECTATION, NOT A MEASUREMENT -- for Phase 4/Step 6: no far-field E_z has been solved for on this geometry. Every 'measured' figure from the 8cm transcription (55.885 V/mm on this grid, 55.996 coarse, the 0.199% spread, the 56.498/56.040 chord numbers, the index-115 grid-plane check) has been DELETED rather than carried over: different depth, different spacing, different field. Do not reinstate any of it, and do not write a new number here until it has been measured. The coarse/fine spread is EXPECTED to exceed 0.199% because the coarse pad-area snap worsened from +1.1% to -11.1%. pixelPlaneWidth 0.1 is INERT in this configuration: with enableInsulatorFR4 true and both thickness keys present, the generator derives pp_width and overwrites whatever this key says. SHIELD GRID OFF (GridHoleShape 'None'): inherited from the older with-grid task13 work, never intended for this WOGRID LArPix v2a geometry. GridPotential/PcbWidth/HoleRadius are inert and left in place. GridPotential does NOT enter the cathode calculation: the bulk field is set by the CATHODE against the PIXEL PLANE at 0 V. TILE SIZE: Npixels 5, i.e. a 5x5 pad tile at the 4.4mm pitch = 22.0mm transverse for the weighting probe; the DRIFT field is one periodic tile, so Npixels does not size this file's domain.
_cathode_description: PHASE 2 RETARGET OF THE CATHODE KEYS. driftZDepth is now 160.6, the cathode Dirichlet plane this config actually produces, stated literally instead of a launch node that gets silently rounded up (the launch node lives in launchZ). Geometry is UNCHANGED: hybrid_iterate._extents:233 gives ceil(160.6/0.55 - 1e-9) = ceil(292.0 - eps) = 292 cells = 160.6mm, the same 293-node coarse / 1607-node fine domain as driftZDepth 160.1 produced. CathodePotential = -BulkField * (cathode plane - pad plane) = -50.0 * (160.6 - 9.9) = -50.0 * 150.7 = -7535 V. The old -7510 was derived across the LAUNCH-NODE-to-pad distance (150.2mm) while the voltage is applied at the cathode plane 150.7mm away, so the bulk field came out 7510/150.7 = 49.834 V/mm, not 50.0; measured plane-averaged Ez in scripts/store_hybrid_16cmdrift was 49.8036 V/mm, flat to 6 digits from z=30mm to the cathode (transverse spread in phi 1.4e-12 V at z=40mm) -- not a solver, convergence or hybrid-seam issue. The derivation is written as (cathode plane - pad plane) precisely so it stays a visible function of the coarse spacing and cannot go stale silently the way -7510 did. RESIDUAL, EXPECTED, NOT A DEFECT: the measured bulk will be ~49.970 V/mm rather than exactly 50.000. Fitting the bulk and extrapolating to phi=0 puts the EFFECTIVE anode plane at z=9.808mm, not 9.9, because the coarse pad is grounded on planes 17-19 but covers only 56.25% of the transverse area (pixelSize 3.3 / pixelGap 1.1); field leaks through the inter-pad gaps (mean phi on the gap cells of the pad plane is -25.3 V, and phi at z=0 is -8.12 V rather than 0). Closing that too would need -7539.6, an empirical constant that goes stale whenever pad size, gap, chamfer or coarse spacing moves. -7535 is DELIBERATE: re-derivable from the config alone. Do NOT 'improve' it to -7539.6.
_launchZ_description: launchZ = cathode plane - one FINE cell = 160.6 - 0.1 = 160.5mm, the last full-velocity node BELOW the cathode, which is the definition hybrid_iterate._extents' own docstring gives for the launch node. Paths are drifted on the 0.1mm velocity/drift3d lattice (1607 nodes), so the relevant cell size is the FINE spacing, not the 0.55mm coarse one. The previous launch at driftZDepth 160.1 sat 5 fine cells lower, an artifact of driftZDepth being overloaded (hybrid_iterate._extents rounds it UP to the cathode plane while starts used it LITERALLY as the launch z), not a deliberate choice. Measured at z=160.5 in scripts/store_hybrid_16cmdrift: Ez = 49.80360632 V/mm, identical to the bulk to 9 digits, no cathode distortion; v_z = -0.00159798 uniform across all 44x44 transverse cells, full bulk drift; weighting potential W = 0.0 exactly (mean and max) -- the last plane with any nonzero W is index 1600 (z=160.0mm), W decaying roughly linearly toward the grounded cathode (Wmax 0.00497 at 140mm, 0.00249 at 150mm), so the W=0 shelf is only the last ~0.6mm and 160.1 sat just inside its near edge. Drift length becomes 150.6mm (was 150.2), ~94.2us transit at v_z 0.0016 mm/ns, comfortably inside the '0*us,200*us,0.05*us' window at scripts/run-pixel-field.sh:405.
